attributes.name: secondary promo banner layout
attributes.definition: Form factor and composition of secondary promotional banners on the page.

values.definition: Slim horizontal banner with a small thumbnail image alongside text/button.
Large, full-width or tall banner with prominent imagery.
Banner without imagery, only text and/or links.

attributes.name: promo banner call-to-action style
attributes.definition: How the action element in promotional banners is rendered.

values.definition: Button with outline/border and transparent or light fill.
Plain text link rather than a button.

attributes.name: promo banner subline
attributes.definition: Whether promotional banners include a descriptive secondary line beneath the main heading.

values.definition: A supporting descriptive line sits below the main heading.
Only a heading/title with no supporting line.
